title: Scalloped-Cavity Mooncake Mould Paddle
description: One original complete static Mid-Autumn Festival mooncake-mould-inspired wooden paddle. A thick square mould head has a genuinely recessed eight-scallop cavity, a complete thick floor and full interior walls. A separate raised eight-petal die relief rests on the whole finite cavity floor. A tapered fixed handle has a genuine through hanging aperture and a complete finite end-face joint to the head. Three complete editable closed meshes and three opaque constant untextured PBR wood tones. Metres, native Z up, cavity facing +Z, presentation front -Y and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. The entire broad head underside is grounded, with real air beneath the raised handle. One complete prop and zero scenes. No mooncake food, dough, utensil set, text, logo, texture, person, motion or surrounding scene.
